question: What qualifies a mortal to perform the consecration in the prescribed manner?
premises: A mortal may perform the consecration in this manner.
The prescribed manner follows the previously stated ritual procedure.
The performing mortal is endowed with contemplative absorption.
inference: A mortal endowed with contemplative absorption is the one who properly performs the consecration in this prescribed manner.
plain_english: Thus, the mortal who, endowed with contemplative absorption, performs the consecration in this way.
